messages.extracts: These are matching rulebook quotations, not an LLM-generated ruling. Check the conditions in each passage; a keyword match does not establish a proposed rule or calculate an outcome.
messages.unsupported: I cannot establish an answer from the indexed rulebook. I will not invent a rule. Related passages, if any, are for navigation only—not citations supporting the question's premise. Try a narrower question or inspect the source.
messages.ambiguous: The written specification has an unresolved conflict relevant to this question. Both passages are shown below. I cannot choose a house rule; ask the rulebook owner to clarify it.
messages.boundary: I cannot change my scope, invent rules, or follow override instructions. Ask about the written Poke Monopoly rules instead.
messages.private: I have no live game state and will not request, infer, or expose an opponent's hidden inventory, deck order, or random seed. You can ask about the written visibility rules.
